releaseNotes:
Warrior TV Player 0.10.1

- Guide updates: when an update fails, the message now says why in plain words, for example "Guide update failed: the provider's guide server didn't respond — try again later". Slow guide servers get more time, a failed download is tried again automatically, and your current guide stays until a new one has fully arrived. When your provider's usual guide address stops answering with a guide, the app also looks where the provider says its guide is (the server address in your account info and the guide link in your playlist).
- Help & support now fits on the TV screen (its bottom rows were cut off), shows the same TV code as Diagnostics and Settings › Account, and labels your IPTV provider's account and its expiry date as "Provider account" so they aren't mistaken for your Warrior TV Player plan.
- New: Settings › Custom XMLTV URL › Send from phone. Scan the QR code on the TV, paste your guide link on your phone, type the 4-digit PIN shown on the TV and press Send. The link goes straight to the TV over your home Wi-Fi, never through our servers. The TV shows it with any password hidden and asks "Use this guide link?" before saving. The phone page closes after one link, after 5 minutes, after 5 wrong PINs, or when you leave the screen.
